title.zh: OpenAI窃听案牵出沙特王室：领馆出面保释，法官仍拒绝放人
title.en: OpenAI窃听案牵出沙特王室：领馆出面保释，法官仍拒绝放人

current_state.zh: A US judge denied bail to a Saudi engineer accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI executive meeting room, after prosecutors revealed his contacts with a Saudi royal and his use of OpenAI's internal agent to query meetings with Saudi officials.
current_state.en: A US judge denied bail to a Saudi engineer accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI executive meeting room, after prosecutors revealed his contacts with a Saudi royal and his use of OpenAI's internal agent to query meetings with Saudi officials.
